label: early original-phase input (positions 1-2) of letters w/s/t/e/c/v/f/z/j/u/n
explanation: Fires mainly in the original phase at steps t=1 and t=2 (84% of activation mass), plus some at t=3. It never fires at t=0, almost never at the delimiter, and rarely in the copy phase (about 9% of mass, scattered). Within those early steps it depends on the token: w is strongest (the top activations are w at t=2 after u/e/w), followed by s, t, e, c, v, f, z, then j, u, n. k, r, l, g and similar letters rarely fire. Magnitude also depends on the earlier tokens (e.g. w at t=2 after y-u or h-u gives near-max), and that context dependence is not captured, which accounts for many false positives (e.g. f/t/e at t=2 in some contexts stays silent). Predicate dev F1 0.66, mass recall 0.80.
